title: Fixed-degree finite local freeness descends to a finitely generated quotient subideal
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f : X -> S a quasi-compact, separated, locally finitely presented morphism of schemes, g : Spec(A) -> S any morphism, I an ideal of A, and r a natural number. If the base change of f along Spec(A/I) -> Spec(A) -> S is finite locally free of degree r, then there is a finitely generated ideal J contained in I for which the base change along Spec(A/J) -> Spec(A) -> S is finite locally free of degree r.

source.place: Tag 07RZ, proof, second paragraph; Limits, Tag 06AC

proof.text: Form the directed poset of finitely generated subideals J <= I, with bottom zero and upper bounds given by sums. Define the quotient diagram J |-> A/J and its cocone to A/I. To prove it colimiting, take the compatible map from A/0 and precompose the quotient map from A. Every x in I is killed at the stage generated by x, so the map factors through A/I. Naturality from the bottom stage proves the factorization and uniqueness. All diagrams and maps are real Lean constructions.

Apply Spec to obtain a limiting cone of affine schemes. At the initial zero ideal, base change f along Spec(A/0) -> Spec(A) -> S. Its source is compact by quasi-compactness and is quasi-separated by separatedness. Form the corresponding morphism in the over category with identity target. The standard iterated-pullback isomorphism and the target pullback of an identity identify its over-category base change with the base change of f along the composite. Fixed-degree finite local freeness is stable under arbitrary pullback: finiteness, flatness and local finite presentation are stable, and fibreDegree_of_isPullback proves the degree equality.

Use descend_finite_locally_free on this affine inverse system and the initial over-category morphism. Its fixed-degree clause gives a later finitely generated index J. Quotient-map composition and the same iterated-pullback isomorphism identify the resulting degree-r morphism with pullback.snd f (Spec.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) followed by g). The index itself supplies J <= I and J.FG.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fg_subideal_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [IsSeparated f]
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : Spec A ⟶ S) (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ)
    (hI : (pullback.snd f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) ≫ g)).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree r) :
    ∃ J : Ideal A, J ≤ I ∧ J.FG ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) ≫ g)) r
